themes.title: Energy Policy as Political Battleground
themes.blurb: Right‑wing outlets in the United States and Norway frame energy decisions as partisan fights, with U.S. media rallying against offshore wind projects while Norway’s far‑right pushes for rapid nuclear development. The parallel framing treats energy policy as a tool for mobilising their bases.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration challenges offshore wind permits and promotes Russian diesel deals, portraying green projects as wasteful and harmful to voters.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Norwegian Progress Party demands immediate nuclear licensing, criticizing delays in clean‑energy policy as political obstruction.

signals: shared framing of energy as partisan
